title: Quarm
summary: Quarm loses heads as its health falls, changing its area spells while renewing a trio of time vortexes.
overview: Quarm loses heads as its health falls, changing its area spells while renewing a trio of time vortexes.

phases.label: Four heads
phases.description: Control three vortexes and the opening five-spell selection.

phases.label: Three heads
phases.description: Quarm loses the red head, clears its buffs and changes its spell set.

phases.label: Two heads
phases.description: The blue head is lost and the spell set changes again.

phases.label: Final head
phases.description: The white head is lost; finish Quarm through the final two-spell selection.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Three time vortexes appear almost immediately on engagement and are replaced every fifty seconds. Assign add control without losing pressure on Quarm.
At 76%, 51% and 26% health, a head is destroyed. Each transition removes all buffs from Quarm and changes its available area spells.
Area spells normally repeat every twenty-five seconds. A head transition resets that timer to six seconds, so prepare the raid for a quick follow-up.
Reapply needed debuffs after each head loss. Keep healers ready as the spell set narrows through the final phase.
Leaving combat removes the vortexes. Five minutes without combat restores Quarm’s health, heads and opening phase.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
